title: About Eco Clean
text:
Eco Clean is an experienced company and US investor in Kosovo, offering textile and laundry services for hotels, restaurants, hospitals and other industries throughout Kosovo and the region.

Our mission is to enable a safe workplace, excellent customer service, and motivated, dedicated employees through the excellence and quality of our work.

title: Our values
text:
Dedicated to everything we do. Maximum responsibility. Honesty and integrity. Caring for our people, customers, suppliers and the environment. Continuous excellence.

Our vision: to be the best service provider in the cleaning sector and in ready-made textile products for your business.

title: Hotels
text:
Eco Clean offers high-quality services in the hotel and hospitality sector. We understand that the services we provide shape your customers' impression, while meeting your business and operational needs.

We collect contaminated sheets and towels, return them clean, and provide a consistent first-class service. Our range balances luxury and affordability without compromising quality.

title: Restaurants & uniforms
text:
Eco Clean provides cleaning services, tablecloths, towels, napkins, coloured napkins, different designs and microfiber towels for restaurants.

Each uniform is individually barcoded for quality control. We inspect garments, make needed repairs before cleaning, and ensure uniforms go through complete thermal disinfection.

title: Hospitals
text: Eco Clean provides durable, hygienically tested, high-quality sheets and uniforms for healthcare. Our cleaning system uses six different chemicals at the right temperatures to eliminate bacteria and stains, in accordance with the safety guidance cited in the catalog.

title: Streamline system
text:
Eco Clean uses the Streamline system to monitor and manage supply levels so customers have the right amount on their shelves.

COUNT: Count clean stock and send the figures once per week.
CALCULATE: Eco Clean calculates delivery stock using last week's delivery, last use and current stock forecast.
REVIEW: Stock is reviewed so supplied quantities comply with business requirements.
DELIVER: Sufficient stock is transported once a week. Express services are available in emergencies.
